name: Bodonhely (Hungary)
description: White field with wavy horizontal stripes of red, white and green along the bottom edge, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Bodonhely (a crowned green shield with a saint, a church and a crescent, within a wreath) above a red scroll inscribed BODONHELY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bodonhely arms with crown, wreath and scroll
